# Sitrifor

> Digital ecosystem for tattoo artists and studios. Product: 634 - iOS app for sketches, pigments, and ink inventory (not booking CRM).

Site: https://sitrifor.ru
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/634/id6795944683
Language: Russian primary (EN/DE UI on site)

## Product facts

- 634 is a tattoo artist workbench: projects with sketches, pigment matching, ink stock
- 634 does not replace studio online booking or cash desk
- Sitrifor also offers session cost calculator and aftercare guides on the website
- Company / brand: Sitrifor
